subject: facet_wrap and, moving x-axes to the top and y-axis to the right

messages.author: 763a6a3271cbd006
messages.subject: facet_wrap and, moving x-axes to the top and y-axis to the right
parts:
Hi,

I am using ggplot2 to move the x-axes to the top of the plot and y-axis to the right side of the plot. I am however finding that the x-axis is being staggering in a weird way and the bottom x-axes is not being removed. Any insight and help would be helpful.


library(ggplot2)
library(reshape)
library(plyr)
#library(scales)
library(grid)
#library(plotrix)
library(gtable)


p <- ggplot(data=goterm2.dm.t.melt) + geom_tile(aes(x=samplename, y=godesc,fill = as.numeric(as.vector(value))), alpha = 1,width=1, height=1) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2("P value",low = "#FFFB00",mid="#FAF757", high = "#000000", na.value = "#000000",trans = "log") +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue", "blue", "white","red","red4"),breaks=c(-3,-1,0,1,3))+
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = c("S1" = "S1","S2" = "S2", "S3" = "S3","NA" = "", "R2" = "R2","R3" = "R3", "R4" = "R4")) + 
  facet_wrap(~regulation, scales = "free_x", ncol = 6) +
  theme(panel.margin=unit(0, "lines"),plot.title = element_text(lineheight=10, face="bold"),
        panel.border=element_blank(),
        panel.background=element_blank(),panel.border=element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),axis.title.x=element_blank(),axis.title.y=element_blank(), 
        strip.text.x=element_text(size=15,face="bold"),legend.text = element_text(size=12, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.width=unit(2,"line"),legend.key.height=unit(2,"line"),legend.position=c(-0.1,0.5),
        legend.title=element_text(size=12, face = "bold"),axis.text=element_text(size=12))

## Get gtable
g <- ggplotGrob(p)


for (i in c(1:6)){
  print(i)
  panelname<-paste("panel",i,sep="-")
  
  ## Get the position of the plot panel in g
  pp <- c(subset(g$layout, name == panelname, se = t:r))

  # Copy xlab from g and swap margins
  #index <- which(g$layout$name == "xlab")
  #xlab <- g$grobs[[index]]

  #heights <- xlab$heights
  #xlab$heights[1] <- heights[3]
  #xlab$heights[3] <- heights[1]
  #xlab$vp[[1]]$layout$heights[1] <- heights[3]
  #xlab$vp[[1]]$layout$heights[3] <- heights[1]

  #xlab$children[[1]]$hjust <- 1 - xlab$children[[1]]$hjust 
  #xlab$children[[1]]$vjust <- 1 - xlab$children[[1]]$vjust 
  #xlab$children[[1]]$y <- unit(1, "npc") - xlab$children[[1]]$y

  # Put xlab at the top of g
  #g <- gtable_add_rows(g, g$heights[g$layout[index, ]$t], pp$t-1)
  #g <- gtable_add_grob(g, xlab, pp$t, pp$l, pp$t, pp$r, clip = "off", name="topxlab")

  # Get axis (axis line, tick marks and tick mark labels) from g
  axisname<-paste("axis_b",i,sep="-")
  index <- which(g$layout$name == axisname)
  xaxis <- g$grobs[[index]]

  # Move the axis line to the bottom (Not needed in your example)
  xaxis$children[[1]]$y <- unit.c(unit(0, "npc"), unit(0, "npc"))

  # Swap axis ticks and tick mark labels
  ticks <- xaxis$children[[2]]
  ticks$heights <- rev(ticks$heights)
  ticks$grobs <- rev(ticks$grobs)

  # Move tick marks
  ticks$grobs[[2]]$y <- ticks$grobs[[2]]$y - unit(1, "npc") + unit(3, "pt")

  # Swap tick mark labels' margins
  heights <- ticks$grobs[[1]]$heights
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$heights[1] <- heights[3]
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$heights[3] <- heights[1]
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$vp[[1]]$layout$heights[1] <- heights[3]
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$vp[[1]]$layout$heights[3] <- heights[1]

  ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$hjust <- 1 - ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$hjust 
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$vjust <- 1 - ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$vjust 
  ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$y <- unit(1, "npc") - ticks$grobs[[1]]$children[[1]]$y

  # Put ticks and tick mark labels back into xaxis
  xaxis$children[[2]] <- ticks

  # Add axis to top of g
  g <- gtable_add_rows(g, g$heights[g$layout[index, ]$t], pp$t)
  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, xaxis, pp$t+1, pp$l, pp$t+1, pp$r, clip = "off", name = "axis-t")

}
